headline: Chest-high-plus S swell with clean cross wind — best of the three today.
today: Solid for the region with total faces to 3.3ft and a good angle, and the wind stays cross-to-cross-on and manageable most of the day. Morning WSW cross is the cleanest before it swings cross-on late afternoon around the 5:58 high. Shortboard or fish will actually have something to work with — this is the day.

daysToWatch.note: Still chest-high on a good angle with cross wind holding all day — another fun one, one of the better sessions of the week.
Swell fades under 2ft and dawn wind screams to 25mph W. Rough morning, though it lightens and goes offshore by evening.
Flat at barely a foot and 20-25mph wind all day. Skip it.
